title: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 2: Nidhamu mezani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child orders words by the first letter, then the second, then the third, and finds the word to read its meaning.
steps: If the same, look at the second.
Open the dictionary near that letter.
Read the meaning and use it.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child orders the three words (maji, meza, mkate) and finds one in the dictionary.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kati ya "samaki", "sahani" na "sufuria", neno linalokuja kwanza ni ___." Kwa nini "samaki" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maneno yakianza kwa herufi moja, tazama herufi ya pili, kisha ya tatu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kati ya "ua", "ardhi" na "wali", neno linalokuja kwanza ni ___." Kwa nini "ua" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kamusi hupanga maneno kwa mpangilio wa alfabeti, si kwa urefu wa neno.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kati ya "baba", "mto" na "zeze", neno linalokuja kwanza ni ___." Kwa nini "zeze" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Alfabeti huanza na a na kuishia na z. Neno lenye herufi ya mwanzo karibu na a hutangulia.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kamusi hutusaidia kupata ___ ya neno." Kwa nini "picha" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kamusi ni kitabu chenye maneno na maana zake, yaliyopangwa kwa mpangilio wa alfabeti.
